sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at my hotel after several days away.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My clothes need washing, so I ask at reception.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can I use the laundry room tonight?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, it's downstairs, past the door to the garden.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, how much is it to wash my clothes?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It's four pounds, and the detergent's included in the price.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got liquid detergent in a small container.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's fine, but you won't need your own.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Does that include drying my clothes as well?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, the dryer's two pounds extra for each cycle.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check the hotel's laundry page before paying.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The page says last wash at eight, is that right?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yeah, start before eight so you've got time to finish.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, how long does the wash cycle usually take?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: About thirty minutes, then you can move to a dryer.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I use this basket to carry my clothes downstairs?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, just bring it back when you're done.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, and can I borrow an iron after the wash?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, we've got one here, just ask later.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll pick it up later, after my clothes are dry.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem, and keep the iron in your room overnight.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before I leave, the receptionist mentions a change.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The dryer's out of order, but the garden one's two pounds.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which dryer can I use for my clothes tonight?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The one by the garden, two pounds a cycle.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Got it, I'll use the dryer by the garden instead.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, take your basket with you too.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I pay for both here, or do I pay downstairs?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Pay here, and we'll give you coins for the machines.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, one wash and one dry cycle, please.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's six pounds, and here's your change.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've checked the cost and found a working dryer.
